props: Create a production modular pixel-art furniture atlas for a cozy indoor GitHub developer conference RPG. TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. Exactly 4 columns and 3 rows of equally sized square cells, 12 isolated objects, each centered with 12% transparent padding, no object touching another cell. Total aspect ratio 4:3. Camera classic top-down three-quarter RPG like Simile town, straight front edges horizontal, NOT diamond isometric. Detailed crisp 16-bit pixel clusters, thin dark outlines, warm terracotta wood, teal upholstery, purple accent screens, consistent light top-left. No text, no labels, no humans, no room floors, no background. Row 1 left to right: (1) wide teal upholstered sofa facing viewer with cushions (2) round wooden coffee table with laptop and mugs (3) indoor potted leafy plant in large terracotta pot (4) wooden check-in reception desk with two monitors and purple front panel. Row 2: (5) purple demo kiosk with large screen and small standing desk (6) warm wood café bar with espresso machine and cups (7) electronics workshop bench with robot arm and components (8) double-sided wooden bookcase low room divider filled with books. Row 3: (9) stage platform with large purple presentation screen and two slim speakers (10) cluster of six purple auditorium chairs in two rows (11) indoor discussion table surrounded by four teal seats (12) freestanding indoor direction sign with three blank arrow panels. Fine detailed pixel art suitable for cropping each cell into separate game sprites, consistent scale, exact regular 4x3 cell alignment, real alpha transparency.
player: A production game sprite sheet on transparent background. Exactly 3 columns and 4 rows evenly spaced equal cells, 12 sprites of ONE friendly conference attendee with dark hair, teal jacket, tan pants, purple backpack and lanyard badge. 16-bit hand pixel art, top-down three-quarter RPG view like detailed cozy pixel town. Row1 faces down, row2 faces left, row3 faces right, row4 faces up. Each row walking left foot, idle, walking right foot. All same scale, identical proportions and feet baseline within each cell. Separate sprites with ample empty padding, no text, no scenery, no shadows outside sprites. Crisp pixel clusters, small chibi proportions, readable silhouette. Transparent alpha.
